inputs.text: One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is J: that output is 10V only while both of them are high.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is K: that output is 10V only while both of them are high.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is L: that output is 10V only while both of them are high.
One of the two inputs into the gate whose output is M: that output is 10V only while both of them are high.

outputs.text: 10V while A and B are both high, 0V as soon as either of them goes low.
10V while C and D are both high, 0V as soon as either of them goes low.
10V while E and F are both high, 0V as soon as either of them goes low.
10V while G and H are both high, 0V as soon as either of them goes low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
